english.title: Interfere with / remove / displace a stone / soil / turf etc within Parliament Square Garden without permission
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), within the central garden of Parliament Square, without the written permission of the Mayor or a person authorised by the Mayor to give such permission, interfered with, removed or displaced a stone, paving slab, soil, turf, or part of a plant, shrub or tree, namely **(..SPECIFY STONE, SLAB ETC..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 5(1)(n) of the Parliament Square Garden Byelaws 2012 and section 385(3) of the London Authority Act 1999.

english.notes: (i) See byelaw 9 where a person must, on demand, provide their name and address should an authorised person have reasonable ground to believe a person has contravened the byelaws.
